log.text: Gholdengo used Make It Rain → Gengar

decisions.rationale: Lead Mega Gengar to Taunt Whimsicott and OHKO Gholdengo; Grimmsnarl Fake Out disrupts and sets screens. Rotom-Mow Thunderbolt 2x vs Tauros/Blastoise/Politoed; Empoleon Ice Beam/Flash Cannon 2x vs Whimsicott and resists Fairy/Water/Ice. Avoid Garchomp with Gengar (Earthquake hits Poison).
decisions.notebook: Series tied 1-1. Opp G2 lead Whimsicott+Gholdengo; brought Tauros-Aqua, Blastoise; Maushold/Politoed unused. Mega Gengar outspeeds (Timid 200>184) and OHKOs Gholdengo (Ghost 2x). Rotom Thunderbolt 2x vs Tauros/Blastoise/Politoed; Leaf Storm 2x vs Politoed/Blastoise. Empoleon Ice Beam/Flash Cannon 2x vs Whimsicott (Grass/Fairy); resists Fairy/Water/Ice; Competitive boosts on Intimidate. Grimmsnarl Fake Out (+3) stops Follow Me/Whimsicott. G3 bring Gengar, Grimmsnarl, Rotom-Mow, Empoleon; lead Gengar+Grimmsnarl; Taunt Whimsicott T1; manage Protect PP; avoid Garchomp+Gengar (Earthquake hits Poison).

decisions.rationale: Lead Whimsicott and Scarf Gholdengo for immediate Prankster Tailwind, Taunt control, and strong spread pressure while Good as Gold blocks opposing status. Keep Maushold for Follow Me/Feint utility and Tauros for fast Fighting- and Water-type offense against Empoleon and other targets. Avoid centering the team around Mega Blastoise because Rotom-Mow is a major counter.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 plan: prioritize Whimsicott preservation and pair its speed/control with immediate Gholdengo pressure. Gengar-Mega and Rotom-Mow often rely on Protect; Encore or Taunt can exploit forced turns, but damage must be timed into them. Rotom-Mow is dangerous to Tauros and Mega Blastoise, so do not overcommit to a Blastoise-centered mode. Grimmsnarl may use early Fake Out; Empoleon's Competitive makes casual Intimidate unfavorable. Slowbro Trick Room is a key control threat; stop it with Whimsicott Taunt when feasible.

decisions.rationale: Mega Gengar Shadow Ball 2x OHKOs Gholdengo; Grimmsnarl Fake Out (+3) flinches Whimsicott before its faster Prankster Tailwind, denying speed control. Mega first (Speed 200) to threaten Gholdengo; Fake Out prevents Whimsicott's setup.
decisions.notebook: Series tied 1-1 (G3). G3 bring Gengar, Grimmsnarl, Rotom-Mow, Empoleon; lead Gengar+Grimmsnarl. Mega Gengar (Timid, Spd 200) Shadow Ball 2x OHKOs Gholdengo; but Gholdengo Choice Scarf can reach 204 > 200, so it may act first—verify Gengar survives its Shadow Ball. Grimmsnarl Fake Out (+3) stops Whimsicott Tailwind (Whimsicott 149-184 outspeeds Grimmsnarl 80, so Taunt too slow). Rotom Thunderbolt 2x vs Tauros/Blastoise/Politoed; Leaf Storm 2x vs Politoed/Blastoise. Empoleon Ice Beam/Flash Cannon 2x vs Whimsicott; Competitive boosts on Intimidate. Avoid Garchomp+Gengar (Earthquake hits Poison). Manage Protect PP.

decisions.rationale: Gengar fragile but Moonblast only 0.5x (9.6-29.6%, not guaranteed KO). Empoleon resists Whimsicott's Moonblast (Steel 0.5x), pressures it 2x with Flash Cannon/Ice Beam (Rotom-Mow only 15-45% 0.5x), and gains Competitive +2 SpA if Tauros Intimidate switches in. Bulkier as a potential lone survivor. Switch Empoleon; Gengar passes.
decisions.notebook: Series tied 1-1 (G3). Gengar-Mega Timid Spd 200; Shadow Ball 2x vs Steel/Ghost. Grimmsnarl Fake Out (+3) stops faster Prankster Tailwind (Whimsicott 149-184 > Grimmsnarl 80). Empoleon Competitive +2 SpA on Intimidate (Tauros); resists Fairy (Moonblast 0.5x) and Water; Flash Cannon/Ice Beam 2x vs Whimsicott (Fairy/Grass). Rotom-Mow Thunderbolt/Leaf Storm 2x vs Water (Blastoise/Politoed/Tauros); resists Water; Will-O-Wisp burns physical. Whimsicott FocusSash survives one KO, needs 2 hits. Opponent bench unknown 2 of {Blastoise, Maushold, Tauros-Aqua, Politoed}. Avoid Garchomp+Gengar (Earthquake hits Poison). Manage Protect PP.

decisions.rationale: Taunt Gengar blocks Protect and opposing Taunt, preserving future control despite Grimmsnarl’s Fake Out. Gholdengo’s spread Make It Rain acts before both foes and heavily pressures Grimmsnarl, with a possible OHKO while also damaging Gengar.
decisions.notebook: Whimsicott preservation and speed control remain the priority. Gholdengo’s Choice Scarf Make It Rain is strong spread pressure but lowers its Special Attack, so avoid unnecessary repeated use. Gengar-Mega and Rotom-Mow may exploit Protect; Encore or Taunt can punish them. Stop Slowbro Trick Room with Whimsicott Taunt when feasible. Intimidate is unfavorable into Empoleon because of Competitive. Rotom-Mow is dangerous to Tauros and any Blastoise-centered plan.

decisions.rationale: Keep Whimsicott active for priority Tailwind, while Maushold's Follow Me can redirect Gengar's attacks or Taunt and preserve Whimsicott's support action.
decisions.notebook: Prioritize preserving Whimsicott and establishing speed control early. Gengar-Mega is a fast offensive threat with Shadow Ball, Psychic, Protect, and Taunt; Encore or Taunt can punish predictable defensive or setup turns. Avoid unnecessary repeated Choice-locked Make It Rain use after its Special Attack drops. Be cautious using Intimidate into Empoleon because of Competitive. Rotom-Mow threatens Tauros and Water-centered plans. Stop Slowbro Trick Room with Whimsicott Taunt when feasible.

decisions.rationale: Gengar survives Moonblast (non-crit max 26.7% < 28% left), so Taunt on Maushold is safe and disables FollowMe/Protect next turn, enabling a Whimsicott focus. Empoleon Ice Beam on Whimsicott: if FollowMe up it's redirected to Maushold (chip), if down it breaks Whimsicott's Focus Sash. Whimsicott is unkillable this turn (Sash even vs crit), so setup is correct.
decisions.notebook: Series tied 1-1, G3. Gengar-Mega Timid Spd 200; Shadow Ball 2x vs Steel/Ghost; survives Moonblast (0.5x). Empoleon Competitive +2 SpA on Intimidate; resists Fairy/Water; Flash Cannon/Ice Beam 2x vs Whimsicott (Fairy/Grass). Rotom-Mow Thunderbolt/Leaf Storm 2x vs Water (Blastoise/Politoed/Tauros-Aqua); resists Water; Will-O-Wisp burns physical. Whimsicott FocusSash: needs 2 hits to KO; Prankster Tailwind. Maushold FollowMe redirects single-target; immune to Ghost; FriendGuard. Opponent bench = 1 of {Blastoise, Tauros-Aqua, Politoed}. Plan: Taunt Maushold to kill FollowMe, then double Whimsicott (sash break + KO). Avoid Garchomp+Gengar (Earthquake hits Poison). Manage Protect PP.

decisions.rationale: Use Follow Me to protect Whimsicott from Gengar’s targeted Taunt or Psychic and Empoleon’s targeted attacks, then establish Tailwind with Prankster. This preserves the priority speed-control plan while Maushold absorbs redirected pressure; Shadow Ball is already ineffective into Maushold.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega is at 27% and is a fast offensive threat with Psychic, Shadow Ball, Protect, and Taunt. Empoleon is bulky, slow, Calm, and has Competitive, Leftovers, Surf, Flash Cannon, Ice Beam, and Protect. Preserve Whimsicott when possible, establish Tailwind early, and use Taunt to stop Slowbro Trick Room when it appears. Avoid Intimidate into Empoleon unless necessary; Competitive punishes it. Rotom-Mow threatens Tauros and Water-based plans.

decisions.rationale: Gengar Protect (priority +4) outpaces Whimsicott's Prankster (+1) to block its move and keep our fragile 28% Gengar safe; Empoleon Ice Beam is 2x SE and can OHKO the 85% Whimsicott (52.7-102.2%, sash already spent). Robust vs Moonblast/Encore/Taunt; finish next turn if not KO'd. Maushold frozen/Taunted cannot act.
decisions.notebook: Series tied 1-1, G3 decider. Gengar-Mega Timid Spd 200; Shadow Ball 2x vs Steel/Ghost; survives Moonblast (0.5x). Empoleon Competitive +2 SpA on Intimidate; resists Fairy/Water; Flash Cannon/Ice Beam 2x vs Whimsicott (Fairy/Grass), Ice Beam (90 BP) outdamages Flash Cannon (80) on any fixed defender and can OHKO at low HP. Rotom-Mow Thunderbolt/Leaf Storm 2x vs Water (Blastoise/Politoed/Tauros-Aqua); resists Water; Will-O-Wisp burns physical. Whimsicott FocusSash (needs 2 hits at full); Prankster Tailwind + status priority; faster under Tailwind. Gengar Protect (prio +4) outpaces Whimsicott Prankster to block status/attacks. Maushold FollowMe redirects; immune to Ghost; FriendGuard; Taunt shuts FollowMe. Opponent bench = 1 of {Blastoise, Tauros-Aqua, Politoed}. Plan: Taunt Maushold, double Whimsicott (sash break + KO), avoid Garchomp Earthquake on Poison. Manage Protect PP.

decisions.rationale: Switch Maushold to Tauros while Whimsicott uses priority Encore on Gengar’s last move, Taunt, locking the fast threat out of attacks and Protect. This preserves Whimsicott, avoids wasting frozen Maushold’s turn, and brings Tauros in safely to pressure Empoleon and Gengar next turn.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega is locked by Encore if its last move is Taunt; Empoleon remains bulky with Competitive and Leftovers. Preserve Whimsicott when possible, keep Tailwind pressure, and use Taunt or Encore to prevent Slowbro Trick Room when it appears. Avoid unnecessary Intimidate into Empoleon. Rotom-Mow threatens Tauros and Water-based plans.

decisions.rationale: Encore Gengar-Mega’s revealed Taunt, preventing it from using damaging moves while preserving Whimsicott. Maushold is frozen and Taunted, but Population Bomb is the strongest available pressure into Empoleon if it thaws; Feint is weaker and Empoleon is not immune.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega has revealed Shadow Ball, Taunt, and Protect; its Taunt can be Encore-locked. Empoleon is bulky with Competitive and Leftovers. Slowbro remains the key Trick Room threat: Taunt or Encore it immediately if it appears. Preserve Whimsicott and Tailwind pressure; avoid unnecessary Intimidate into Empoleon. Rotom-Mow threatens Tauros and Water-based plans.

decisions.rationale: Double Whimsicott: Empoleon Ice Beam (2x) and Gengar Shadow Ball both guarantee KO from 28% even at Focus Sash (sash irrelevant off-full). Whimsicott is faster (Tailwind) and Moonblast only 0.5x vs Gengar (possible but not guaranteed KO), so trading Gengar for the faster threat is fine. Maushold is frozen + Taunted and cannot act. Removes the only real threat; leaves Empoleon+Rotom-Mow vs frozen Maushold + 1 unknown bench.
decisions.notebook: Series tied 1-1, G3 decider. Gengar-Mega Timid Spd 200; Shadow Ball 2x vs Steel/Ghost (felled Gholdengo); survives Moonblast (0.5x). Empoleon Competitive +2 SpA on Intimidate; resists Fairy/Water; Ice Beam (90) 2x vs Whimsicott (Fairy/Grass) and OHKOs at low HP, outdamages Flash Cannon (80). Rotom-Mow Thunderbolt/Leaf Storm 2x vs Water (Blastoise/Politoed/Tauros-Aqua); resists Water; Will-O-Wisp burns physical. Whimsicott FocusSash only at full HP; Prankster Tailwind+status priority; faster under Tailwind. Maushold FollowMe redirects; immune to Ghost; FriendGuard; Taunt shuts FollowMe. Opponent bench = 1 of {Blastoise, Tauros-Aqua, Politoed}. Plan: double Whimsicott to remove faster threat, then clean frozen/Taunted Maushold; bring Rotom-Mow vs Water bench; manage Gengar Protect PP (consecutive use reduced).

decisions.rationale: Encore Empoleon to constrain its next action and prevent flexible Protect usage while Maushold switches into Tauros. This preserves the frozen, taunted Maushold and brings in a strong Close Combat threat; Whimsicott is likely to be targeted but still applies the immediate control.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega has revealed Shadow Ball, Taunt, and Protect; its Protect was previously targeted by Encore but was blocked. Empoleon is bulky with Competitive and Leftovers. Slowbro remains the key Trick Room threat: Taunt or Encore it immediately if it appears. Preserve Tailwind pressure when possible, avoid unnecessary Intimidate into Empoleon, and remember Rotom-Mow threatens Tauros and Water-based plans.

decisions.rationale: Taunt Gengar prevents another Protect or disruptive Taunt and preserves pressure despite Whimsicott being in Ice Beam KO range. Population Bomb is Maushold’s strongest legal attack into Empoleon; it may thaw and deal meaningful chip, while Gengar is immune to Normal moves.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega has revealed Shadow Ball, Psychic, Protect, and Taunt; Protect was previously targeted by Encore but blocked. Empoleon is bulky with Competitive and Leftovers and has revealed Ice Beam. Slowbro remains the key Trick Room threat: Taunt or Encore it immediately if it appears. Preserve Tailwind pressure when possible, avoid unnecessary Intimidate into Empoleon, and remember Rotom-Mow threatens Tauros and Water-based plans.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Gengar is Taunted (no Protect) at 28% and Tauros Close Combat OHKOs Empoleon (123-180%). Empoleon Protects to block it; Gengar switches to Rotom-Mow (2x Thunderbolt counter), removing the low-HP Taunted Gengar from danger. Opponent has no bench (only Tauros + frozen Maushold), so we keep both and clean up next turn.
decisions.notebook: Series 45b84c6b7e98 G3 decider (tied 1-1). Opponent brought Whimsicott, Maushold, Gholdengo, Tauros-Paldea-Aqua; Blastoise/Politoed NOT brought -> no bench. Whimsicott Prankster Tailwind+status, FocusSash (only at full HP), faints to Psychic/Ice. Maushold FollowMe redirect + FriendGuard, immune to Ghost, Taunt shuts FollowMe, freezes easily. Tauros-Aqua Intimidate, BlackBelt, CloseCombat 2x vs Empoleon (OHKO), AquaJet priority can pick Gengar. Gengar-Mega Psychic 2x vs Tauros/Fighting; Shadow Ball 0x vs Normal. Empoleon Competitive +2 SpA on Intimidate. Rotom-Mow Thunderbolt/LeafStorm 2x vs Water (Tauros), resists Water, Will-O-Wisp burns physical. Plan: Protect Empoleon vs Tauros CloseCombat, switch Gengar->Rotom-Mow, then Thunderbolt+IceBeam clean up; finish frozen Maushold last.

decisions.rationale: Raging Bull acts first under Tailwind and guarantees the KO on Gengar-Mega, removing its Psychic threat. Maushold is frozen, but Population Bomb into Empoleon is the best available action if it thaws; it does not create a Competitive trigger.
decisions.notebook: Opponent's Gengar-Mega set is Shadow Ball, Psychic, Protect, and Taunt. Empoleon has revealed Ice Beam and Competitive; it is bulky and carries Leftovers. Slowbro remains the key Trick Room threat and should be Taunted or Encored immediately if it appears. Rotom-Mow threatens Tauros and Water-based plans. Avoid unnecessary Intimidate into Empoleon.

decisions.rationale: Rotom Thunderbolt (2x, min 94.5%) + Empoleon Surf (min ~42%) sum >100% so Tauros dies if Maushold doesn't redirect, while Surf also OHKOs the 15% Maushold for an immediate double-KO. If Maushold Follow Me's, Thunderbolt redirects and kills it, Tauros only chips and Close Combats Empoleon, but Gengar (Spd 200) + Rotom still finish Tauros next turn. All paths win.
decisions.notebook: Series 45b84c6b7e98 G3 decider. Opponent G3 team: Whimsicott(Prankster,Tailwind/Taunt/Encore/Moonblast,FocusSash), Maushold(FollowMe/FriendGuard/Jolly/WideLens, immune Ghost, Taunt shuts FollowMe, freezes easily), Gholdengo(GoodasGold/ChoiceScarf/MakeItRain), Tauros-Paldea-Aqua(Intimidate/BlackBelt/Jolly, CloseCombat 2x OHKOs Empoleon, AquaJet priority, RagingBull Water). Blastoise/Politoed NOT brought. Counters: Gengar-Mega Psychic 2x vs Tauros/Fighting, ShadowBall 0x vs Normal; Empoleon Competitive +2 SpA on Intimidate; Rotom-Mow Thunderbolt/LeafStorm 2x vs Water Tauros, resists Water, WillOWisp burns physical. Plan: Taunt Maushold to disable FollowMe, Ice Beam freezes it, then Thunderbolt/IceBeam clean; finish frozen Maushold last; Protect Empoleon from CloseCombat.

decisions.rationale: Only Gengar-Mega (28% HP, SpA222/Spe200) remains vs Tauros(100%,-1Def/SpD)+Maushold(15%). Psychic GUARANTEES Tauros OHKO (166-197%) when it lands. Only Maushold FollowMe(prio+2) redirects it (sacrificing itself, then Tauros RagingBull guaranteed-KOs Gengar); Feint(prio+2) only breaks Protect. Mind-game: Attack beats Feint/non-redirect, Protect beats FollowMe. Real ~50% win chance; forfeit is 0%. Switch Gengar in, read opponent turn 7.
decisions.notebook: Opponent team: Whimsicott(Prankster,Tailwind/Taunt/Encore/Moonblast,FocusSash), Maushold(FollowMe/FriendGuard/Jolly/WideLens, Normal immune Ghost, Taunt shuts FollowMe, freezes easily), Gholdengo(GoodasGold/ChoiceScarf/MakeItRain), Tauros-Paldea-Aqua(Intimidate/BlackBelt/Jolly, CloseCombat 2x OHKOs Empoleon, AquaJet prio+1, RagingBull Water). Blastoise/Politoed NOT brought. Counters: Gengar-Mega Psychic 2x vs Tauros/Fighting (guaranteed OHKO on -1SpD Tauros), ShadowBall 0x vs Normal; Empoleon Competitive +2 SpA on Intimidate; Rotom-Mow Thunderbolt/LeafStorm 2x vs Water Tauros, resists Water, WillOWisp. Mind-game vs Maushold+Tauros: Maushold FollowMe(prio+2) redirects Gengar attacks blocking Tauros KO; Feint(prio+2) breaks Protect. Attack beats Feint, Protect beats FollowMe.

decisions.rationale: Maushold’s Population Bomb pressures Rotom-Mow for a potential KO before it can threaten Tauros, while Tauros uses super-effective Close Combat into Empoleon. This maximizes immediate damage against both foes; Follow Me risks losing Maushold without stopping Empoleon’s spread Surf.
decisions.notebook: Opponent has Mega Gengar, Empoleon, Rotom-Mow, and bench options Garchomp/Slowbro; Slowbro’s Trick Room remains the key future threat. Empoleon is bulky, carries Leftovers, Ice Beam, Surf, Flash Cannon, Protect, and Competitive; avoid unnecessary Intimidate into it. Rotom-Mow threatens Tauros with strong Electric/Grass attacks and resists Water. Mega Gengar carries Shadow Ball, Psychic, Protect, and Taunt. Preserve remaining offensive pressure and prioritize stopping Trick Room if Slowbro appears.

decisions.rationale: Empoleon fainted so slot 2 must Pass. Psychic on Tauros is 2x super-effective into its -1 SpD and is a guaranteed OHKO, removing the only real offensive threat. Maushold is immune to Ghost so Shadow Ball is wasted; Psychic also can't be redirected usefully since Maushold at 15% would die if it tries Follow Me. Best value is deleting Tauros.
decisions.notebook: Opponent series team: Whimsicott(Prankster,Tailwind/Taunt/Encore/Moonblast,FocusSash), Maushold(FollowMe/FriendGuard/Jolly/WideLens, Normal immune Ghost, Taunt shuts FollowMe), Gholdengo(GoodasGold/ChoiceScarf/MakeItRain), Tauros-Paldea-Aqua(Intimidate/BlackBelt/Jolly, CloseCombat 2x OHKOs Empoleon, AquaJet prio+1, RagingBull Water). Blastoise/Politoed NOT brought. Counters: Gengar-Mega Psychic 2x vs Tauros (guaranteed OHKO on -1SpD), ShadowBall 0x vs Normal; Empoleon Competitive +2 SpA on Intimidate; Rotom-Mow Thunderbolt/LeafStorm 2x vs Water Tauros, resists Water, WillOWisp. Mind-game vs Maushold+Tauros: Maushold FollowMe(prio+2) redirects Gengar attacks blocking Tauros KO; Feint(prio+2) breaks Protect but Normal is 0x vs Ghost Gengar. Attack beats Feint, Protect beats FollowMe.

decisions.rationale: Maushold uses Follow Me to protect Tauros from any single-target attack, while Tauros uses Raging Bull for a guaranteed KO on Mega Gengar. This also remains effective if Gengar Protects or Taunts, preserving the winning position.
decisions.notebook: Opponent's confirmed game-3 roster included Mega Gengar, Empoleon, Rotom-Mow, and bench options Garchomp/Slowbro. Slowbro's Trick Room is the key future threat; stop it immediately if it appears. Mega Gengar carries Shadow Ball, Psychic, Protect, and Taunt. Empoleon is bulky with Leftovers, Ice Beam, Surf, Flash Cannon, and Protect; avoid unnecessary Intimidate into Competitive. Rotom-Mow threatens Tauros with Electric/Grass attacks and resists Water.

reflections.summary: Game3 and series lost 1-2 because team-preview plan mismatched opponent: leading Grimmsnarl (Fairy/Dark) into Gholdengo Make It Rain spread caused turn-1 loss of screen setter, crippling Mega Gengar to 28% and removing late-game insurance. Between-game adjustment of bringing Rotom-Mow and Mega Gengar helped vs Tauros Water but backfired as Rotom died to Maushold Population Bomb and Empoleon wasted Protect then fell to Close Combat, leaving Gengar alone; Maushold Follow Me redirected Gengar Psychic, letting Tauros finish Gengar. Prep registered six included weak-to-Steel Grimmsnarl and frail Rotom; left-behind Slowbro or Garchomp would have better soaked spread and matched Tauros.
reflections.adjustment: Future series: drop Grimmsnarl from bring set; bring Slowbro or Garchomp with Empoleon, Mega Gengar, and Rotom-Mow/Arcanine. Use Taunt on Maushold before Follow Me or freeze workaround; avoid Protect stalemate vs Population Bomb. Keep Empoleon for Competitive/Intimidate but position to survive Close Combat. Preserve Gengar HP by not leading into spread; still Mega for Psychic OHKO on Tauros after Intimidate.
reflections.notebook: Opponent series team: Whimsicott(Prankster,Tailwind/Taunt/Encore/Moonblast,FocusSash), Maushold(FollowMe/FriendGuard/Jolly/WideLens, Normal immune Ghost, Taunt shuts FollowMe), Gholdengo(GoodasGold/ChoiceScarf/MakeItRain spread super effective vs Fairy/Dark), Tauros-Paldea-Aqua(Intimidate/BlackBelt/Jolly, CloseCombat 2x OHKOs Empoleon, AquaJet prio, RagingBull Water), Blastoise/Politoed possible unconfirmed. Revealed facts: Gholdengo lead punishes Fairy/Dark; Maushold Population Bomb crits frail Rotom; Follow Me redirects Gengar Psychic; Empoleon Competitive +2 SpA on Intimidate but dies to Close Combat if unprotected. Prep conclusions: avoid Grimmsnarl lead; bring Slowbro/Garchomp for bulk; keep Empoleon+Gengar core; Rotom only for Water resist but beware multi-hit; Taunt Maushold early.

reflections.summary: Won Game 3 and the series 2-1 because Tauros and Maushold recovered after an unfavorable opening: Gholdengo traded for Grimmsnarl while Mega Gengar survived, then Maushold's Population Bomb and Tauros's Fighting attacks removed Rotom-Mow and Empoleon before Tauros finished Gengar. The opening four were broadly capable, but leading Whimsicott into Fake Out and leaving Gholdengo exposed to Shadow Ball made the early plan costly; Taunt and freeze further disrupted it. No specific between-game adjustment is documented, so the series win cannot be credited to a proven adjustment; the in-game recovery helped, while the opening execution and Intimidate into Competitive were liabilities. The registered six were serviceable, with Whimsicott's speed control, Maushold's redirection, and Tauros's coverage fitting well. Gholdengo's Choice Scarf Make It Rain was powerful but risky into Mega Gengar. Mega Blastoise was not brought or evolved; without its set or evidence from the earlier games, there is no basis to call it better, though its omission should be reconsidered. The sets of the four brought generally fit, but the preview plan needed a safer anti-Fake-Out/Gengar lead. There is no demonstrated evidence that Gliscor, Qwilfish, Morpeko, or Meowstic-F would have been superior; Gliscor is the most plausible alternative to test for Ground pressure, but Rotom's Levitate limits that case.
reflections.adjustment: Against a rematch, do not lead the Whimsicott-Gholdengo combination without protection from Fake Out and immediate Mega Gengar pressure. Preserve Gholdengo or pair it with a better answer to Gengar, and use Maushold's Follow Me only when it can act before Taunt or status disables it. Avoid Intimidate into Empoleon unless Competitive is deliberately acceptable. Reconsider the four at preview: test Mega Blastoise or another sturdier Gengar/Empoleon answer rather than automatically repeating the same group, while retaining Tauros if its Fighting pressure remains valuable. Treat Slowbro as a real Trick Room possibility if brought, but do not overprepare for it without confirmation in the matchup. No documented between-game adjustment needs to be retained as successful.
reflections.notebook: Mega Gengar is an aggressive special attacker with confirmed Shadow Ball, Psychic, Protect, and Taunt; it can punish exposed Gholdengo and disrupt support. Grimmsnarl has Fake Out, dual screens, and Taunt, so support leads need anti-Fake-Out or immediate protection. Empoleon is bulky, uses Leftovers and Protect, carries Ice Beam, Surf, and Flash Cannon, and its Competitive makes Intimidate risky. Rotom-Mow carries Life Orb, Thunderbolt, Leaf Storm, Will-O-Wisp, and Protect; it resists Water and pressures Tauros. Slowbro was a bench option with confirmed Trick Room, so check for it at preview rather than assuming it is absent. The successful core idea was redirection plus Tauros's Fighting coverage, but the lead must avoid losing tempo to Fake Out, Taunt, and Mega Gengar's super-effective attacks. Future preparation should compare Mega Blastoise and the unused draft options for sturdier early-game pressure, while keeping Whimsicott only when Tailwind or Taunt can be protected.
